'''Battle Droid Atherna''' was an experimental assault [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] constructed by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]], it was deployed to protect an outpost of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] under attack by [[Havoc Squad]], but was destroyed by [[Aric Jorgan]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]]<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Battle Droid Atherna appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' Chapter 11: Disavowed.
